activity_summary: At midnight you said he gets it wrong by a minute, and that the minute is all the villainy in it. You did not add a line after the dagger. You did not say the play was finished.

facets.activity: Said he gets it wrong by a minute

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He gets it wrong by a minute. One minute. That's all the villainy there is in it.
